items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Willie Smith, Nat Cole, myself, Red Callender, we all used to go out and play them for him to help him out.

ctx.x: Yes, she has. You know, when we met

Norman, he was just running little jazz sessions out at the True Building. He's giving -- he'd give us (unintelligible) come into L.A. And he just finished UCLA, and when we'd come in L.A. he would try to run these sessions. And he'd give us $9.00 to go out there. And he had the money to play these little things out there at Trueville and little places like that. Willie Smith, Nat Cole, myself, Red Callender, we all used to go out and play them for him to help him out.
What -- do you remember what year that was?
